summary: Shipped example prompt spans substitute prose for an artifact that failed to read — build's per cite and plan's four artifacts — and nothing downstream refuses
acceptance: An absent PER_PATH refuses the build render; a plan artifact present but unreadable refuses; an absent one still renders its placeholder
tests: the example build template's per span fails the render when the cited spec path is absent
the example plan template's artifact spans fail the render when an artifact is present but unreadable
pins: the example plan template's artifact spans render their empty placeholders when the artifacts are absent
notes: Sites: build.md:14 `cat "{{PER_PATH}}" 2>/dev/null || echo`; plan.md:4,8,12,16. Same shape as the shipped <spec-corpus> guard (8379b65) one rung quieter — these fallbacks are reachable. Absence is legitimate on tick one for the plan artifacts, so guard with `test -e`, not `-f`, which lets a directory render the placeholder. chmod injection is a win32 no-op (open-questions, windows lane); a directory in place of the file is the portable unreadable case.
